title: Allow controlled corrective Work Items during active calibration

sources.reason: Authoritative P1 requirement for a calibration-bound corrective route.
Current Work Item start state machine and fail-closed lifecycle checks.
Authoritative persisted calibration Session state model.
Canonical Work Item and successor lifecycle boundary.

riskAssessment.reason: Start authorization and calibration evidence must remain fail-closed while preserving normal no-session starts.

reasons: The route changes governed lifecycle authorization, Contract validation, receipts, and visible status.

executionDecision.reason: The user authorized autonomous execution and this Contract defines the bounded corrective route and verification.

preReviewWarnings: Reject every ordinary Work Item while a live calibration Session exists.
Do not write, resume, activate, or claim completion of a calibration Session from the corrective route.
Require exact Session digest and explicit correction authority; stale or malformed evidence must fail closed.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record immutable scope before implementation and final evidence before Finish.

acceptance: When `.ai/calibration/session.json` records a live `in_progress` or `paused` Session, an ordinary `ai-start` request is rejected before it writes Contract, Summary, Start Receipt, or Cockpit Status.
A `calibrationCorrective` start is admitted only when its schema, Session path/digest/id/state, finding ID, authority evidence, bounded repair paths, and dedicated branch are all valid and current.

The corrective binding is persisted in the Contract and Start Receipt, validated on later lifecycle checks, and projected in active Cockpit status without changing the Session or declaring calibration complete.

A missing, malformed, cross-session, stale, non-live, or over-broad corrective declaration fails closed with an actionable recovery message; normal starts remain compatible when no live Session exists.

Focused unit and linked lifecycle regressions prove normal rejection, valid corrective admission, stale/tampered rejection, receipt binding, and status projection; lifecycle and command documentation describe the safe resume boundary.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.
Fail closed when lifecycle identity or authorization evidence is not exact.

intent.problem: A calibration workflow can uncover a template or governance defect, but a normal Work Item must not silently run beside an unfinished calibration. The existing start path neither identifies this state nor records an authorized corrective exception, leaving a lifecycle deadlock or an unprovable bypass.
constraints: Keep calibration Session files outside the corrective Work Item write scope.
Do not infer human authority, correction findings, or Session identity from free text.
Preserve no-live-session start behavior and existing parallel Work Item boundaries.
Do not create a release, provider action, or calibration activation path.
intent.rationale: A content-addressed corrective declaration makes the exception auditable and narrow: it admits only the named repair against the exact live Session, while all ordinary starts remain blocked until calibration is resumed through its own workflow.

rawUserRequest: Fix the lifecycle deadlock so an active calibration can use a controlled corrective Work Item instead of blocking all repair or allowing an untracked bypass.

declaredIntent.summary: Introduce a content-bound calibration corrective start exception while preserving ordinary-start rejection during live calibration.

problemStatement: Provide an explicit calibration-bound corrective Work Item route that is auditable, scope-limited, and fail-closed without changing calibration state.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A live calibration Session blocks an ordinary Work Item before lifecycle evidence is written.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The start command fails before Contract, Summary, Receipt, or status writes.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A complete corrective declaration bound to the exact live Session starts and persists a verifiable Contract and Receipt binding.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The Contract and Start Receipt bind the same session digest, finding, repair boundary, and authority.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add start and receipt validation regressions.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Malformed, stale, foreign, or over-broad corrective declarations remain rejected and leave the calibration Session untouched.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The command rejects the declaration and no calibration or Work Item evidence is mutated.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add Contract and start-path negative regressions.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User authorized automatic execution of the full remediation plan, including governed Makefile and lifecycle changes.

rollbackNote: Revert the corrective-route implementation and its tests/docs; the prior normal no-session start behavior remains intact.
